fe_snapshot_comparison: NOT_RESOLVED_BY_CONNECTED_GITHUB_COMPARE_404; implementation based on verified dev source, not a claim of equivalence

limits.policy: Preserve existing P03 SAVE/read/replay capacity. Align the P19 linked validator with the existing staging RECORD cap; SAVE acceptance never implies Post eligibility.
limits.oversized_saved_snapshot: 501-1000 rows remain readable, privately owned and unchanged. FE keeps RECORD disabled; no automatic truncation, split, duplicate draft, new key or switch to canonical protocol.
limits.invalid_record: Existing HTTP 422 validation before owner writes; no synthetic rejection/success receipt or negative proof. Preserve original pending intent and CHECK_ONLY recovery rules.
limits.capacity_increase: RECORD above 500 is not enabled. A future increase requires explicit owner decision, every downstream limit and end-to-end acceptance.

permission: warranty.component_issue AND active actor/stable auth session/confirmed ACTIVE warehouse; persisted case ownership must match warehouse
tenant: No client tenant identity is accepted or fabricated. Use the existing deployment/auth/warehouse boundaries; cross-tenant recovery is not offered.

headers: If-Match: quoted draft version; 0 on first SAVE
save.body: Existing P03 body: warehouse_id, operation=COMPONENT_ISSUE, scan_session_id, codes, form.p19. Client creates and retains lowercase draft/scan UUIDs once.
save.optional_metadata: document_date YYYY-MM-DD or null, note max2000 or null; omitted/null must match record. No manual component_issue_no in this mode.
save.codes: List of raw_code, explicit integer quantity 1..100000 and scan_source CAMERA/SCANNER/HARDWARE/MANUAL. SAVE allows 0..1000 rows; RECORD allows 1..500. Preserve exact strings, order, quantity and source; never automatically trim an oversized snapshot.
save.duplicate_box_input: P03 disallows repeated exact raw_code. Sum repeated user withdrawals into the same local BOX row before SAVE; separate aliases of one container still share its availability and are revalidated by owner.
save.recovery: SAVE replay uses its original key/body/If-Match; read receipt with command=SAVE. No canonical CREATE/SCAN retry is implied. Snapshot is not validated stock/scan evidence.

resolve.body: warehouse_id, raw_code, warranty_case_id; existing owner contract
resolve.rules: ITEM quantity1, available_qty may be null (not 0/1); BOX requires explicit quantity and container availability. Only resolved eligible component plus case_allows_issue=true permits confirmation. Resolver does not reserve or prove future availability; record revalidates.

record.if_match: DO_NOT_SEND; this batch command binds X-Draft-Version, not a pre-existing business document version
record.items: 1..500 rows; both linked and staging validators enforce this limit. More SAVE capacity does not authorize a larger RECORD.
record.post_immediately: Explicit JSON true required. false is not SAVE. Do not call separate canonical Post afterward.
record.snapshot_match: items correspond exactly to saved codes including quantity/order/scan_source; form.p19 metadata must match, ownership/status rechecked under locks
record.result: data.component_issue_document_id is the business ID. data.p19_result is a durable historical Post projection included before P03 receipt commits.
record.lines: line_id/line_no/sku_id/required_qty/scanned_qty/version from persisted lines; quantity_total is summed quantity, never number of rows
record.movements: movement_id/line_id/sku_id/item_id nullable/negative qty_delta/occurred_at from actual COMPONENT_ISSUE ledger rows; never created_at as posted_at
record.receipt: meta.p03_draft.receipt.command=RECORD; request_id equals ORIGINAL Idempotency-Key. Receipt version is draft version; document_version is business version. trace_request_id is separate HTTP correlation.
record.atomicity: Owner document, scans, container consumption, inventory movements, P03 RECORDED mapping and receipt share one transaction. Replay returns historical result, no second decrement.
record.stock_effect_distinction: P03 staging document.stock_effect=NONE describes the draft only. The business record/Post in data.p19_result has DECREASE. Never infer neutral business stock from staging NONE.

reconcile.receipt: data.receipt and data.response describe the earlier command; data.document/business_status are current readback. Do not overwrite current state with historical response.
reconcile.unknown: P19 UI only checks; preserves original key/body/draft/scan/version. P03 SAME_REQUEST_ONLY is an owner restriction, not permission for automatic write retries. No new document, no key rotation and no cancellation as a workaround.
reconcile.unsupported: No dedicated receipt for historical canonical create/scans/post or standalone/unlinked record. No definitive NOT_POSTED/NOT_RECORDED from null/404/DRAFT. Do not apply other owners' receipt URLs.

resume.business: GET /api/v1/mini-app/warranty-component-issues/{business_document_id}; existing owner permission and warehouse ACL
resume.decision: DRAFT resumes the private saved batch without business CREATE/SCAN. RECORDED opens its existing business_document_id and reads document.posted_at/status/lines. Back/reload/GET do not create events/documents. Do not convert an existing canonical SCANNING document into this batch mode.
resume.session: Refresh retains stable family. New login/other actor cannot take over old P03 receipts or drafts. Local logout remains available; preserve private scoped evidence but do not replay under a new session. No credentials in checkpoint.
resume.mutation: No P19 unscan/delete/cancel API. Existing P03 cancellation is only for confirmed DRAFT under its owner rules; never delete posted evidence or cancel UNKNOWN.

release.ci: Run P19 plus unchanged owner tests on isolated SQLite/PostgreSQL; exact SHA/counts/style are reported separately
release.concurrency: Competing saved batches and transactional rollback/replay tests are not a claim of physical-device or production load/race certification; live concurrency remains a release gate
release.schema: No P19 migration; existing P03 drafts/receipts, warranty ownership and canonical stock/container schema must already be deployed
remaining: DEV/BA review of selected P19 mode
release.prohibited: No live Post without explicit approved test account/case/item/box/balance. No seed/migration/test writes on DEV to fabricate evidence. No production customer stock, new camera/torch/scanner APIs or fixture fallback.
